input.instructions: Explain how a stack and a queue remove items. Give one everyday example of each.
input.criterion: 3. Gives one everyday example of a stack and one everyday example of a queue.
input.submission: A stack removes the most recently added item first, like a pile of plates. A queue removes the earliest added item first, like customers waiting at a service desk.
